logo.description: Coat of arms of the University of Leicester. Shield : Gules an open book strapped Proper and buckled and inscribed with the words "Ut Vitam Habeant" in letters Or between in chief two cinquefoils pierced Ermine and in base a horseshoe also Or. Crests : On a wreath of the Colours Argent and Gules a demi-gryphon segreant Or holding between the claws an open book as in the arms.
